dedupe_keys.name: best fit for elastic optical networks

description: Lidia Ruiz at Universidad de Valladolid publishes BestFit_EON, an OMNeT++ implementation of a dynamic elastic optical-network simulator. It represents wavelength-routed optical networks, dynamic routing and wavelength assignment, flexible spectrum allocation and optional protection or semi-static modes. The release supports the IEEE Access study on multi-path routing and best-fit routing, modulation and spectrum assignment. Zenodo supplies a ZIP archive free under CC BY 4.0 and links the university's GitLab repository. The June 2026 archived release extends an earlier baseline implementation. It is not tied to one country or observation period; those depend on network and demand inputs, whose full schema and time-step settings remain unknown from the landing page. The code can support optical-capacity and allocation experiments. OMNeT++ compatibility was not tested here, and no related catalogue record was explicitly verified.
